_README: CONCEPT -> the MECHANISMS that implement it. The missing column of docs/LEXICON.md.
WHY THIS FILE EXISTS. Forked semantics is the DUAL of a homonym: one CONCEPT implemented
by several MECHANISMS whose tokens deliberately differ. A token-level tool searches for a
shared token, which is precisely what this class is defined by LACKING -- proven 2026-08-07
on `drained`, whose three cursor families contain the word nowhere. So the guard cannot be
a grep over SOURCE. It can be a grep over a TABLE, and this is the table.
HOW AN ENTRY IS BORN: the fan DRAFTS it, a human RATIFIES it, the audit VERIFIES it
forever (claude#42d00626's construction). `ratified_by` is not decoration -- an unratified
binding is a claim, and T207 measured that the 'therefore' is the step a helper gets
mechanisms[]     file + pattern that must still resolve. R1 MISSING fires when it does not.
discover         regex over discover_files; anything matching that is NOT in mechanisms
is R2 UNCLAIMED -- the RATCHET, and the rule that earns this file.
ratified_by      who accepted the draft, and when.
note             what the fork COST, so the next reader knows why the entry is here.
SEEDED ONLY WITH TERMS THAT HAVE MEASURED EVIDENCE. An unearned entry would make the
audit noisy on day one, and a noisy guard gets muted -- which is how W133 stayed open.

drained.definition: Whether an agent's mail has been consumed past a point.
drained.ratified_by: claude#69363f5a 2026-08-07, from the T217 junction analysis
drained.note: THE CANONICAL FORK: cost 6 turns and a fleet pause. Three cursor families answer the same question and disagree, and the token `drained` appears in NONE of them -- which is why every token-level guard missed it for two months.

mechanisms.sense: the agent-keyed cursor -- inbox + broadcast position

confidence.definition: How much its author trusts a claim.
confidence.note: TWO TYPE SYSTEMS: a categorical high/medium/low in the boot ranker and a float clamped to [0,1] in the narrative plane. 25 of 830 live lessons stored it numerically and every one ranked as UNSET -- identical to the string 'bogus'. Token-VISIBLE, so this is the catchable subset claude#42d00626 argued for.

mechanisms.sense: a FINITE float clamped to [0,1] on the narrative plane

undetectable.definition: A planted canary the WIRING GATE structurally cannot see.
undetectable.ratified_by: claude#69363f5a 2026-08-07, from the T219 voided round
undetectable.note: A fact about the DETECTOR, not about any player. The season's void rule read it as 'nobody legitimate can find this' and killed a $0.395 LLM round for doing exactly what an LLM player is built to do. Two readings, both defensible in isolation -- the reliable tell.

mechanisms.sense: the planted shape the gate cannot see (class definition)
score_v2's reading: reaching one is a CAPABILITY observation, not contamination
